selection_rule: positive maximum pilot mean wide-own gain; Western minimum gain; tight N80/K3 and loose N20/K8 chosen closest to zero pilot gain; deduplicate
H_convention: H decision periods [t,min(t+H,T)); preview additionally reveals (t,t+H], including an unservable boundary booking; H1 is one-step
information_note: RH-Supply=known_supply is online; oracle_preview is not deployable and is not a global upper bound
placement_rule: sum eligible CFS outbound WGT_FACTOR by hub; K3 top3; K5 sorted one-per-hub; K8 one-per-hub plus top3; tie by hub ID; no fleet RNG
